title: Malicious code in photo-video-uploader (npm)
description: The photo-video-uploader npm package contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. This compromise may allow an attacker full control over the affected system. Immediate rotation of all secrets and keys stored on the compromised computer is advised, using a different, clean machine. Simply removing the package does not guarantee removal of all malicious software introduced by it.
